biography:
== Biography ==
Mary Sullivan was born in Ireland about 1844, the daughter of James Sullivan and Joanna Connors.<ref name="reg1868">"Massachusetts, State Vital Records, 1638-1927", database with images, FamilySearch (https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:FHGX-R4D : accessed 18 November 2026), Thomas McElligott and Mary Sullivan, married 7 Nov 1868, Charlestown; Charlestown Marriage Records 1843-1874, entry 255 (image 509 of 686). Groom 24, laborer, born Ireland, parents Patrick McElligott and Catharine Moore; bride 25, born Ireland, parents James Sullivan and Joanna Connors; married by Rev. George A. Hamilton, Charlestown.</ref><ref name="tmmarr1868">"Massachusetts, U.S., Marriage Records, 1840-1915", database, Ancestry (https://www.ancestry.com/search/collections/2511/records/7907390 and https://www.ancestry.com/search/collections/2511/records/17907390 : accessed 17 November 2026), Thomas Mc Elligott, 24, born Ireland, son of Patrick and Catharine, and Mary Sullivan, 25, born Ireland, daughter of James and Joanna, married 7 Nov 1868, Charlestown.</ref><ref name="marysdeath">"Massachusetts, U.S., Death Records, 1841-1915", database with images, Ancestry (https://www.ancestry.com/search/collections/2101/records/3204834 : accessed 17 November 2026), Mary McAligott, died 17 May 1879, Boston; married, 34, wife of Thomas, born Ireland; father James, mother Joanna; Boston deaths 1879, p. 112, entry 60.</ref>

On 7 November 1868 she married Thomas McElligott, son of Patrick and Catharine McElligott, at Charlestown, Massachusetts.<ref name="tmmarr1868" /><ref name="tmchurch1868">"Massachusetts, U.S., Boston Archdiocese Roman Catholic Sacramental Records, 1789-1920", database, Ancestry (https://www.ancestry.com/search/collections/61585/records/232083 : accessed 17 November 2026), Thomas McElligot and Mary Sullivan, marriage 7 Nov 1868, Charlestown; vol. 48603, p. 106a.</ref> In 1870 the family lived in Charlestown's Ward 1.<ref name="census1870">"1870 United States Federal Census", database with images, Ancestry (https://www.ancestry.com/search/collections/7163/records/26578808 : accessed 17 November 2026), Thomas Mcellgott household, Charlestown Ward 1, Middlesex, Massachusetts, dwelling 1371; NARA M593, roll 625, p. 124B. Thomas 28, laborer, born Ireland; Mary 26; Patrick 5/12.</ref> Their children, all baptised in Charlestown, were Patrick (1870, died in infancy),<ref name="patbapt">"Massachusetts, U.S., Boston Archdiocese Roman Catholic Sacramental Records, 1789-1920", database, Ancestry (https://www.ancestry.com/search/collections/61585/records/220939 : accessed 17 November 2026), Patrick McElligott, baptised 25 Mar 1870, Charlestown; father Thomas McElligott, mother Mary Sullivan; vol. 48609, p. 27.</ref> Mary Ellen (1873-1889),<ref name="mebapt">"Massachusetts, U.S., Boston Archdiocese Roman Catholic Sacramental Records, 1789-1920", database, Ancestry (https://www.ancestry.com/search/collections/61585/records/221193 : accessed 17 November 2026), Mary Ellen McElligot, baptised 18 Aug 1873, Charlestown; father Thomas McElligot, mother Mary Sullivan; vol. 48609, p. 110.</ref> Catherine (baptised 1875),<ref name="cathbapt">"Massachusetts, U.S., Boston Archdiocese Roman Catholic Sacramental Records, 1789-1920", database, Ancestry (https://www.ancestry.com/search/collections/61585/records/297706 : accessed 17 November 2026), Catharinam [Catherine] McElligot, baptised 21 Jan 1875, Charlestown; father Thomae, mother Mariae.</ref> James Thomas (1877-1924)<ref name="jtmbirth">"Massachusetts, U.S., Town and Vital Records, 1620-1988", database, Ancestry (https://www.ancestry.com/search/collections/2495/records/47744464 : accessed 17 November 2026), James McElligott, born 6 Jan 1877, Boston; father Thomas [indexed "Thoams"], mother Mary Sullivan.</ref><ref name="jtmbapt">"Massachusetts, U.S., Boston Archdiocese Roman Catholic Sacramental Records, 1789-1920", database, Ancestry (https://www.ancestry.com/search/collections/61585/records/221418 : accessed 17 November 2026), Jacobum [James] McAlligott, born 6 Jan, baptised 7 Jan 1877, Charlestown; father Thoma McAlligott, mother Maria Sullivan; Boston Archdiocese Sacramental Records vol. 48609, p. 200.</ref> and Margaret (baptised 21 April 1879, died 26 April 1879).<ref name="margdeath">"Massachusetts, U.S., Death Records, 1841-1915", database, Ancestry (https://www.ancestry.com/search/collections/2101/records/3204714 : accessed 17 November 2026), Margaret McElligot, died 26 Apr 1879, Boston, infant; father Thomas, mother Mary.</ref>

Mary died in Boston on 17 May 1879, aged 34, of phthisis and pneumonia. The register describes her as the wife of Thomas and names her parents as James and Joanna.<ref name="marysdeath" />

=== Research Notes ===
* Her age is 25 at marriage (about 1843), 26 in 1870 (about 1844) and 34 at death (about 1845). Her place of origin in Ireland is not known.
